propositions: A project-owned code-review criterion must enforce four-pass phase boundaries: Pass 1 finds candidates without assessing severity/confidence/remediation; Pass 2 verifies validity/impact only; Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment; Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively.

The criterion implementation requires committed prompt at .rebar/prompts/code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries.md with execution_mode single_turn, outputs code_review_findings, routing entry with exec 1-TURN/block_threshold 0.90/blocking_enabled false, and balanced 12-case eval corpus (RP-F1..F6 must fire, RP-N1..N6 must abstain).

The finder must emit grounded evidence only, never include severity/confidence/suggested_fix fields, and abstain when phase ownership is unclear; unchanged grandfathered suggested_fix context is not a finding.
Live calibration across three runs must achieve recall 1.0, false_accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, Cohen kappa ≥0.70, and per-case stability ≥2/3, with all metrics and model/timestamp recorded.

The implementation must change only project-owned files (.rebar/ routing/prompt/eval, tests/unit/test_project_review_phase_boundaries.py, docs/llm-framework.md, .gitignore exceptions) and land on main with zero blast radius to existing review flows.

Runner-backed tests must assert diff interpolation into system prompt, strict output schema (code_review_emits_valid_findings scorer), perfect calibration metrics injection, and docs subsection presence.
